macro_placement_context.record_breaking_note: Crossed the 1,000-offer threshold within the first five days of the drive, shattering previous records
structural_trends: Dual Degree candidates consistently secure higher stipends during internships and are aggressively targeted for deeper architectural roles
Massive migration from core engineering disciplines (Biotechnology, Metallurgy, Mining) to non-core sectors (IT, Product Management, Quant Finance)
Core placement figures for Biotechnology, Metallurgy, and Mining departments approach zero unless candidates pursue higher studies
Students in non-CS disciplines self-educate in Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) to compete for SDE roles

sector_distribution.financial_services: Second largest (Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, AMEX)

macro_placement_context.data_source_methodology: Combination of RTI (Right to Information) petitions, Awaaz campus publication analysis, and crowd-sourced Google Sheets aggregated by the student body via OCR pipelines applied to low-resolution PDF scans provided by the administration
